# treemap fixtures

- `docs-styled.mmd`, `budget-format.mmd`: the Mermaid documentation's treemap examples
  (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/treemap.html), MIT licensed, © Knut Sveidqvist.
- `mermaid-svg-sample.mmd`: copied from `crates/nana-ui-runtime/tests/fixtures/mermaid/treemap.mmd`,

- `cjk-small-leaves.mmd`, `minimal.mmd` are written for this crate.
